desc: The Stealth Operator Full Size is a lightweight, low-profile holster designed to provide minimal print and maximum concealment for many of the most popular full-frame handguns. No frills and no fancy gimmicks; the Stealth Operator Full Size outside-the-waistband (OWB) holster equally comfortable holding your duty weapon or everyday carry. Each Full Size holster features the unique Frame-Lock technology, which ensures positive retention of your firearm. That means that once your weapon locks into the holster, it will stay secure until you need it. Coupled with a super-durable injection molded nylon shell, rust-resistant black oxide hardware, and a robustly flexible design, the Stealth Operator Full Size is the multiple-pistol-owner's dream come true.
